research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Qulture.Rocks is focused on enhancing leadership qualities through a system that assesses and develops leadership skills. The system is designed to process leadership events derived from performance data. This innovation aims to optimize leadership development by leveraging a computer-implemented server to manage and improve leadership capabilities, aligning with the company's goal of advancing people management applications.

about_short_description.short_description: Qulture.Rocks builds people management applications for some of the world's most influential companies.

product.name: Performance Evaluation
product.description: A cloud-based system that replaces manual spreadsheets and forms to manage employee performance evaluations, enabling strategic decision-making and talent identification.

product.name: Goals and OKRs Management
product.description: A platform to organize, track, and align company, team, and individual objectives and key results (OKRs) with customizable dashboards and action plans.

product.name: Individual Development Plan (PDI)
product.description: A tool to define personalized development priorities and paths for employees, supporting motivation and skill growth through tailored action plans.

product.name: 1:1 Meetings Management
product.description: A platform to facilitate regular one-on-one meetings between leaders and their team members, supporting agenda setting, note-taking, and task tracking.

product.name: Feedbacks
product.description: A system to encourage continuous feedback exchange among employees to support ongoing development and performance improvement.

product.name: Compliments (Elogios)
product.description: A platform feature that allows public recognition of employee achievements and contributions within the organization.
